name: Illuminum
storyline:
The once powerful empire Annon is doomed. Demonic powers have conquered its heart, the Illuminum and spread fear and terror in the mazes of this gigantic tower, which was once built by Illumians, the mysterious visitors of a strange world.

Take the role of the brave fighter Eric and lead off the fight against evil! Search for Wohan, the once most powerful warrior of Annon. Conquere the spire of tower and free Illuminum from darkness!
summary: Isometric RPG where we find ourselves in the mysterious tower Illuminum. Kill monsters, become stronger, learn new skills and discover truth about this place.
